headline: Besxar is building an orbital semiconductor factory, one SpaceX rocket at a time
context: Besxar, a startup founded by former OpenAI staffer Ashley Pilipiszyn, wants to make the key precursors for advanced semiconductors by taking advantage of the vacuum of space.
